description.zh: 专用网络中的实例ID（ECS/负载均衡）
description.en: The ID of an ECS or SLB instance in the VPC.

description.zh: 自定义授权名称，需要保持唯一，不能重复
description.en: The name of the authorization. The name must be unique.
The port number that corresponds to the instance.

description.zh: 指定规则所适用的对象标签，可设置多个。
description.en: The tag of objects that match the rule. You can specify multiple tags.

description.zh: 专用网络ID，必须是同账户下可用的专用网络的ID
description.en: The ID of the VPC. The VPC must be an available one that belongs to the same account as the API.
The host of the backend service.

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向开放 API 的用户。
- 授权 API 网关允许访问您的 VPC 实例。
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API providers.

- authorize API Gateway to access your VPC instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi set-vpc-access --name test --vpc-id vpc-uf657qec7lx42paw3qxxx --instance-id i-uf6bzcg1pr4oh5jjmxxx --port 80 --description VPC_description --vpc-target-host-name iot.hu000ng.com --tag Value=123 Key=key --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi SetVpcAccess --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key --Description VPC_description --VpcId 'vpc-uf657qec7lx42paw3qxxx' --InstanceId 'i-uf6bzcg1pr4oh5jjmxxx' --Port 80 --Tag.1.Value 123 --VpcTargetHostName 'iot.hu000ng.com' --Name test
